test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_bf_presence_{budget}_{clustered} (n UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = {budget})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY n SETTINGS index_granularity_bytes = 0
ALTER TABLE json_bf_presence_{budget}_{clustered} ADD INDEX bf j TYPE jsonbf_v1() GRANULARITY 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_bf_presence_{budget}_{clustered} SELECT number, ('{{"id":' || toString(number) || ',"payload":"' || toString(cityHash64(number)) || '"' || if(if({clustered}, number < 10000, number % 100 = 0), ',"x":"present"', '') || '}}')::JSON(max_dynamic_paths = {budget}) FROM numbers(1000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM json_bf_presence_{budget}_{clustered} WHERE isNotNull(j.x) SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {indexed}
SELECT sum(n) FROM json_bf_presence_{budget}_{clustered} WHERE isNotNull(j.x) SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {indexed}
